title: claude-governance-kit configuration
description: The single file that adapts the governance system to one repository. Every dashboard generator reads it and validates each root by its sentinel before touching the filesystem, so a wrong path here fails loudly at generation time instead of silently producing an empty catalog.

projectName.description: Display name, rendered in the dashboard header.

projectShortName.description: Lowercase id used in log file names. Must be filename-safe.

tracker.description: Path to the live defect register, relative to the repository root.

roots.description: The directories the generators walk. Each carries a sentinel — a file or directory that must exist inside it — so a mistyped path is caught before anything is generated from the wrong tree.

kit.description: Where this project's governance kit lives. Changes to kit-owned files are mirrored there (.claude/rules/changing-the-governance-system.md, step 3), and scripts/check-kit-drift.sh compares against it at commit time.

path.description: Absolute path of the local kit clone. Written by install.sh.

remote.description: The kit's git remote, where a mirrored change is pushed so every project can update from it.

projectOwned.description: Kit-owned paths this project deliberately keeps its own version of (a tailored skill, a forked generator), or deliberately does not have (a kit skill it replaced with its own). update.sh never replaces or re-adds them, and the drift check stays quiet about them; kit changes reach them only by hand.

notion.description: Where scripts/obligations-sync.sh mirrors the obligations register (run by the post-commit hook). The Notion key is never stored here: it comes from $NOTION_TOKEN or the macOS Keychain service claude-governance-notion.

database.description: The Obligations database id, printed by scripts/obligations-sync.sh --setup. One database serves every project; the Project property separates them.

reminders.description: Also mirror owed obligations to Apple Reminders (list 'Obligations'), so alerts reach the operator's phone. macOS only.

pathAliases.description: Paths this project moved after ledger entries cited them. Entries are never edited, so the ledger catalog rewrites a cited path that matches `from` (a regular expression) to `to` ($1 etc. are capture groups). Applied in order.

dir.description: The dashboard app directory, relative to the repository root.

syncLog.description: Append-only record of which ledger entries have been published, keyed by entry id. Lives in the repo; never edited by hand.

hookLog.description: Where the session hooks report a skipped sync. Deliberately OUTSIDE the repository — a hook that cannot find the repo must still be able to say so.

path.description: Directory relative to the repository root. "." is the root itself.

sentinel.description: A path inside `path` that must exist. "." means the directory's own existence is the check.
